arguments.subject: Re: why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for reaching out and for your patience as a Pro subscriber. I understand how disruptive this experience is, and I want to clarify what's happening.

We have not introduced any policy that signs users out when switching machines. Your sign-in session should remain active on each device, and there are no limits for Google SSO users like yourself that would cause you to be logged out when switching between computers.

If you're now getting signed out when using multiple devices—especially after this has worked smoothly for a year—this is likely a bug rather than an intentional change. We have not rolled out any session-limiting feature or device binding for regular sign-ins. (Billing actions, like upgrading a plan, can require extra confirmation on new devices, but this does NOT affect your sign-in session.)

To help our engineering team investigate, please let us know if you have:
- Changed your browser privacy settings (e.g., cookie clearing, incognito mode).
- Updated your operating system, browser, or security software recently.
- Noticed any error messages (besides a missing sidebar or inactive agent threads).

If none of the above apply, we recommend contacting human support at support@cursor.com with as much detail as possible, including the devices/OS versions in use and any recent changes to your setup. A human engineer can investigate your account in more depth and track down the cause.

Again, I’m sorry for the frustration here. Let us know if you need a direct handoff to a human engineer—we’ll escalate right away if this impacts your deadline.

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Support

[Reference: https://localhost:5008/kb/payment-method-device-binding, https://localhost:5008/kb/sso-google-signin]

arguments.subject: Re: why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for contacting us, and I really appreciate your clear and detailed description—it helps a lot.

To confirm: there is no new Cursor policy that logs you out of other devices when you sign in on a new one, and device "binding" only affects certain billing actions. Your sign-in session should remain active on all devices unless ended manually or due to a security concern (like forced password reset, OAuth token changes, or cookie issues).

Given your workflow used to function seamlessly across devices and this just started happening, it sounds very likely that you are experiencing an unexpected bug, not any kind of intended session limit. Billing protections, like SCA, do not affect daily sign-in (only billing actions).

Could you let us know if:
- Your browser clears cookies or is set to privacy/incognito mode.
- You recently changed your Google account password, signed out everywhere, or updated your browsers/OS.
- You see *any* warning or error besides the UI disappearing.

If none of the above changed, this needs a deeper, human investigation. Please email support@cursor.com and include:
- Your account email
- Device models/OS
- The browsers you use
- Any recent changes
They will escalate directly to engineering if necessary.

We are sorry for the disruption and will get this resolved—please let us know if you want an immediate human handoff for your deadline, and I’ll escalate right away.

Best regards,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Customer Care
